remarks: This charming one-bedroom apartment in Westport. The kitchen features ample cabinet space, making it easy to keep things organized. The living and dining areas are distinct yet connected, creating a cozy atmosphere for relaxation and entertaining. A laundry closet with a stacked washer and dryer, eliminating the need for off-site laundry trips. One of the standout features is the expansive screened-in porch, which serves as an extended living space for three seasons, ideal for enjoying the outdoors in comfort. Additionally, the apartment comes with off-street parking for one car.
